snippet.description:
President Donald Trump’s extraordinary efforts to help Jensen Huang get reinstated at Nvidia speak to the president’s conviction that the health of the U.S. economy relies on AI and, to a large part, Nvidia’s chips — and that Nvidia needs Huang to be its CEO to remain successful.

Investors are elated, Nvidia’s board is divided, and Democrats and many Republicans in Congress are furious, arguing that Trump is prioritizing the stock market over national security. They’re vowing to hold Huang and members of Trump’s cabinet accountable for selling out American interests.
